reason: The core app is free, so I would install that first and watch my son for a few weeks. I will only pay for PRO once I see he actually remembers letters and numbers and is not just tapping the mascot.
objection: Will my child actually learn, or just play? Kids' apps all say 'learning' but most of them are cartoons with buttons.
would_change_my_mind: If after a week on the free version the parent area clearly showed he had learned new letters, or the free part ran out right when he was getting into it, I would pay the 24,990 without thinking much.
